title: Bond Market Interventions and Ramifications
summary: Treasury duration management and harvesting equity gains.
assessment: The report clearly distinguishes Treasury buybacks from Fed purchases and correctly identifies the duration channel. Its stronger claims about political motive, inevitable repression and asset-market causation are less established. CAKE’s 2023 reentry and the July software entries show observable gains, with later retracements retained.

claims.claim: Iran sanctions are unlikely to end disruption soon.
claims.reason: Persistent disruption into autumn supports the near-term direction. The stronger explanation that sanctions have exhausted their leverage needs trade and enforcement evidence, and “soon” has no defined deadline. Refining constraints independently sustain product-price pressure.

evidence.finding: Distillate and jet-fuel spreads were highest amid refining disruption in Russia, China and the Middle East.

claims.claim: Treasury buybacks differ from Federal Reserve QE.
claims.reason: Treasury must fund purchases from cash or issuance, while a Fed purchase expands reserve liabilities at settlement. Buying off-the-run securities can improve liquidity without directly creating new base money. Consolidated-government exposure and future refinancing still matter.

claims.claim: Unreversed QE permanently monetizes government debt.
claims.reason: QE replaces privately held bonds with central-bank liabilities, but interest-bearing reserves preserve an interest obligation for the consolidated public sector. A balance sheet that does not return to its prior nominal size is not by itself proof of fiscal dominance or permanent deficit financing.

claims.claim: Yield caps can require unlimited bond purchases.
claims.reason: A credible fixed price floor requires the authority to buy whatever eligible supply arrives at that price, subject to implementation terms. This defines a yield-cap commitment; it does not show that the 2026 Treasury buyback program is such a commitment.

coverage_note: Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.

tools_charts.name: FAST Graphs and prior trade episodes

framework_lessons: Separate settlement mechanics, market effects and political motive.
A good historical trade does not make the next valuation judgment certain.
verification_limitations: Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
